bio.text: Laurel Lee was sworn in to the U.S. House of Representatives on January 3, 2023, and represents Florida's 15th Congressional District.
She served as Florida's Secretary of State from January 2019 to May 2022 and as a Circuit Court Judge in Hillsborough County from 2013 to 2019, after working as a federal prosecutor.
She earned a bachelor's degree in political science from the University of Florida in 1996 and a law degree in 1999.
